relationships.subject: repeated cold stress
relationships.evidence_quote: The ATF3-positive cell rate (as a percentage of the total cells per section) was 3.2% on day 1 of RCS, 9.9% on day 3, 15.2% on day 5, and 21.5% on day 7 (Fig. 3d), suggesting that ATF3 expression increases in a stress period-dependent manner.

relationships.subject: PLX3397
relationships.evidence_quote: Microglial accumulation in the spinal cord was significantly reduced in the PLX3397-treated group compared with the vehicle-treated group after RCS

relationships.subject: spinal microglia
relationships.evidence_quote: Concomitant with the suppression of microglial accumulation, PLX3397 treatment led to an increased mechanical withdrawal threshold after RCS, indicating that microglial suppression reduces pain behavior in the RCS model

key_findings: Repeated cold stress in mice induced ATF3 in proprioceptive DRG neurons and microglial activation along the spinal reflex arc.
PLX3397-induced microglial ablation suppressed pain behavior.
